extracted.name: Thai Spiced Barbecue Shrimp
extracted.description: These grilled shrimp are marinated in a flavorful blend of lemon juice, soy sauce, garlic, mustard, and curry paste for an easy weeknight meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled and deveined
instruction_lines: Combine lemon juice, soy sauce, mustard, garlic, brown sugar, and curry paste in a shallow dish or resealable bag. Add shrimp and turn to coat. Cover or seal and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat. Lightly oil the grate. Thread shrimp onto skewers or place in a grill basket. Transfer marinade to a saucepan; bring to a boil and cook for 3 to 5 minutes.
Grill shrimp, turning once and basting occasionally with the boiled marinade, until opaque and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.
